Welcome to the finale of our four-year long Madison events series and Wisconsin's first 3-day competition since 2019. Enjoy every official 3x3 event and more! If you're new to competing, this is a great competition to be your first. 

#### If you are not competing in the 3x3 Fewest Moves event, please do not attend the competition on Friday. Check-in for other competitors takes place on Saturday from 8:00-8:50

This competition is supported by the Midwest Cubing Association.
